## Logger.recommendedLevel property

The recommended log level, `info`<!-- -->.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static readonly recommendedLevel: LogLevel;
```

## Remarks

It is meant for the applications that need a level when none was chosen.

The library never applies it: a logger created without a level stays in the preliminary state, until the level is set, so the application must use this value explicitly, for example `log.level = Logger.recommendedLevel`<!-- -->.

It is read-only: the compiler rejects an assignment, and at run time the class is frozen, so an assignment throws a `TypeError`<!-- -->.

<ul> <li>added in v7.0.0, as the new name of <code>defaultLevel</code></li> </ul>
